evidence.browser: Self-contained hash-pinned runtime verified in the Codex in-app browser at exact 1280x720 and 390x844 CSS pixels; source flag blender-blockout-v0.2.0; desktop/mobile adaptive profiles selected; loader completed; WebGL overlay hidden; warning/error log empty; all four controls visible at the mobile gate.
evidence.motion: Direct control inputs 40 degrees lift, 55 percent extend, -35 degrees swing, and 18 degrees steer reached Holding in the self-contained runtime; Stow returned all four controls to zero and Stowed. The platform remained visually level and the telescope remained nested.
evidence.selection: A direct canvas click on the platform hit volume opened the Platform inspector and activated the platform component; no query shortcut was used for this selection gate.
evidence.silhouette_scope: M2.1 structural review covers the stowed envelope, published tailswing and ground clearance, telescope overlap, platform leveling, and complete working-pose framing. Detailed pivots, nested-section lengths, cylinder anchors, turntable internals, and platform rotator geometry remain outside acceptance.

evidence_boundary: Overall published envelopes are authoritative and approximate per JLG. Telescope travel is a visual overlap cap, not a published stroke. Lift-cylinder geometry is deferred until its anchors are supported. Internal pivot offsets, boom section lengths, turntable internals, and platform rotator geometry remain visually reconstructed or unresolved.
